notes.title: My Lovey-Dovey Demon has been released! 💗
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I'm writing a quick devlog to let you know that my most recent visual novel, [i]My Lovey-Dovey Demon[/i], has been released! Yay \o/

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e869aec72dd4182535668ade5c2d4530d9819120.jpg[/img]

You can check the VN out here, if you're interested:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183430

[i]MLDD[/i] is a VN that's been in process for quite a while. I wrote the script back in 2021, and it took me a while to piece the whole story together. The Steam store page was up for over a year before I finally released it, so some people have been waiting on this one for a while haha

It might have taken me some time to finish this project, but I tried to use this time to ensure that it's as polished as possible! The main artist, [url=https://twitter.com/Kimoreen]Kimoreen[/url], did a great job with the character artwork, and all of the cute chibi cut-ins by [url=https://twitter.com/Konayachi]Konayachi[/url] are adorable!

I also had some help from Harmonie of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44509628]Asminae Games[/url], who created Reborn a Zombie (available for free on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283350]Steam[/url]), to do some work on the various visual effects in this VN. That means this VN has some fun effects during the CGs which I've not added to any of my previous projects such as light rays, animated particles, and moving fog. I think it helps the VN pop, and it brings the story to life!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/76da6cae1c84a845dd2d5c2968af720c4f21c4b5.png[/img]

Speaking of the story, it's a pretty cute, light affair which takes a lot of cues from typical BxG slice of life VNs. It's quite chill and relaxed, and there isn't much in the way of conflict (which might be a bit of a rarity coming from me lol), so this should be a good read if you're looking for something cosy. It's pretty similar to [i]The Language of Love[/i] in that it's a wholesome BxG romance story, though it has a bit more of a comedy focus like [i]My Dear Prince[/i].

Everybody put a lot of effort into this VN, so I hope you all enjoy it! ♡

As always, let me know if you find any typos or bugs in the VN, and I'll try to fix them up within a reasonable timeframe!

- ebi x

notes.title: New build uploaded
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm just making a quick post to let you know I've uploaded a brand new build of [i]The Fairy's Secret[/i]! This newest build fixes up several typos which were found in the English script by a very kind reader, and it also touches up the UI. The buttons in the preferences screen weren't aligned properly, and didn't always register mouse hovers as they should, but this should now be fixed!

I also fixed some transparency issues with the darker variant of the UI, and one of the backgrounds was edited (a window was placed in an illogical location in the hallway of Iris's home, but it has now been removed).

The game should be a lot more polished now! If you find any further issues, however, such as bugs or typos, please let me know. I'll do my best to fix everything up in a timely manner!

- ebi x

notes.title: New build uploaded
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm just writing a quick update to let you know that I've pushed out a new build of this VN with a few typo corrections, plus a fix to the music room which allows all of the tracks to be unlocked. Originally, there was a bug which prevented these two tracks from unlocking properly.

As always, please let me know if you find any issues with this new build (especially any issues related to achievements), and feel free to point out any further typos you might see. It would be very much appreciated!

- ebi

notes.title: Russian translation added + some typo fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! \o/

I’m writing an update to let you know that I’ve recently uploaded a new build of The Fairy’s Secret on Steam. This build adds a full Russian translation to the game, courtesy of Mikhail "KornyPony" Burov-Kosolapin, who also translated The Fairy’s Song. His hard work is very much appreciated!

I also fixed several misc typos in the English script which were pointed out to me, which mostly showed up near the end of the story… I suppose by this point I’d gotten tired and had let some errors slide into the text, oops ;; I’ll try to be more careful when editing my scripts in the future!

I also fixed a sprite display issue which causes Marnie’s sprite to disappear briefly during a scene near the end of the visual novel.

If you encounter any more bugs or typos in this VN, please let me know. You can report your findings in the bug report thread pinned on the Steam community page.

Thank you for your support thus far, and I hope you’ve been enjoying your time with the story!

- ebi x
